purpose: Audit ledger for post-opening mechanistic/context follow-ups mentioned as boundaries in JAE v0.6. These analyses are not headline endpoints.

entries.question: Does coarse ATraiU breeding-water hydroperiod explain species wet/dry response?
entries.result: 23 covered species were all coded flexible_both (temporary and permanent); no hydroperiod-axis variation.
